name: IDF Multi-Modal Forensic Investigation Benchmark
description: A small, hand-constructed benchmark for evaluating agentic multi-modal digital forensics systems: given a case file (chat logs, structured access logs, audio recordings, video clips, and reference photos), can a system correctly answer an investigator's query and cite the right evidence? Built as part of the IDF (Intelligent Digital Forensic System) BE major project, 2025-26.
